fields.note: Leighton faces are 1 mm aluminum on a machined core. The ER-1001 faces are aluminum foil, 0.003 to 0.016 inch in the series, thinner than the lead sheets, and the core on the depth trace is 3/16 inch. Neither is S-200F or SR-200 on CR-III 3/8-1.0. Flatwise tension and the beryllium bond remain unprinted, so the 60 psi amplitudes stay an upper bound only if that F_c is real.
